kind: Date worker discovery startup and warm-frame observations
metadata_note: Both raw reports use the final checkout benchmark driver. Their input_sha256 fields describe that driver checkout, not the published-before binary inputs; exact binary-source attribution is supplied by actual_before/after_source_input_sha256 above. Original raw reports are retained unchanged.
interpretation: Fresh worker startup increases about 10 ms: discovery waits in 10 ms nonblocking I/O polling slices. Warm-frame medians are similar on these fixtures. Replace that deliberate polling wait with deadline-bounded readiness polling in a subsequent measured change; retain cleanup ownership and cancellation. No performance parity claim.

phase_definitions.startup_ms: address authorization + confined renderer spawn/handshake; parent fonts/canvas excluded
phase_definitions.load_ms: Load round trip, including renderer fonts, broker startup, resource reads, HTML parse, script setup and any requested image decoding
phase_definitions.cold_render_exchange_ms: first Render round trip: style/layout, document/image snapshots, IPC copy/validation
phase_definitions.cold_clear_paint_ms: first parent canvas clear + software paint with fresh glyph cache
phase_definitions.render_exchange_ms: warm Render round trip including snapshot generation/copy/validation
phase_definitions.clear_paint_ms: parent canvas clear + software paint with warmed glyph cache
phase_definitions.total_ms: warm render exchange + fragment lookup + clear/paint + snapshot destruction
phase_definitions.teardown_ms: worker/broker channel closure, termination and wait

excluded: desktop event loop and native presentation
before.cold_cache_definition: fresh processes and parent glyph cache; OS/filesystem caches are not flushed
before.aggregation: upper-middle median and nearest-rank p95; warm samples pooled across fresh runs
